title: Incorrect electricity bill directed to be corrected under Supply Code 2005
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Poonam Srivastava and Naheed Ara Moonis, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; bill to be corrected under Supply Code within one month.
headnote: Where the consumer had already obtained an endorsement from the Executive Engineer to correct an electricity bill, the Allahabad High Court disposed of the writ by directing that the bill be corrected in accordance with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within one month of production of the certified copy.
facts: The petitioners, running M/s Ekdil Mini Floor Mill, complained that the electricity bill for connection no. 3601/257260 was incorrect. On 12 March 2010 they applied to the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division-II, Friends Colony, Etawah, enclosing a copy of the bill. An endorsement that day required the dealing assistant (later deleted as respondent no. 4) to make the correction. Counsel for the petitioners and for respondent no. 3, the distribution licensee, were heard.

holding_units.holding: The electricity bill shall be corrected in accordance with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within one month of production of the certified copy of the order before the concerned authority.
holding_units.flag: order invokes the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 generally; no clause numbered

not_decided.point: Whether the billed amount was in fact incorrect, and the quantum of any correction
not_decided.note: The Court directed correction in accordance with the Supply Code without examining the bill.
